description: The Institute of Chartered Accountancy of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standared Act. No 15 of 1995, Publication under section 4(2)
reasoning: This gazette content publishes an amendment to the Sri Lanka Financial Reporting Standard (SLFRS) 16 regarding COVID-19-related rent concessions. It constitutes a regulatory update to accounting standards under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
